about: Operator resolutions of the bare-name collisions reported by tools/laws_exclude.py. These are NOT a new exclusion rule: they apply the registration's existing prose clause (PANEL, 'Excluded': every repo used in any temporal-crucible study to date) to specific candidates that share a name with an excluded project. Each decision cites what the repo actually is, checked against the GitHub API, so a reader can audit the call rather than trust it. Recorded with the draw as Amendment 8 item 1 requires.
rule_applied: A candidate is excluded only if it carries the SOURCE of a studied project, so that drawing it would re-test studied code. A project that merely shares a name is kept - dropping eligible repos that were never studied biases the frame exactly as much as keeping repos that were.
